title: The resume guard refuses a Workflow agent's message to a finished reviewer
why: A Workflow agent can message a reviewer whose worktree is gone, the same gap as a subagent's send; its hook payload is unrecorded too.
note: Held on page item 412 (subagent-payload-probe): no record says which transcript a subagent's PreToolUse transcript_path names, and the lane's probe was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Lane resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree ([ended:lane:-resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree]) runs the probe on pick a. Until 2026-11-21. Filed 06:03 CST Nov 8 (coordinator, 06:01 CST). Owner item 412 a (06:11 CST Nov 8): the lane runs the one-shot probe in its throwaway cloud container, then removes the hook. The settings write still needs words the owner types in that lane's chat. Measured payload shapes (lane resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree, 10:11 CST Nov 8): a main-session Bash payload has no agent_id and no agent_type. A subagent payload carries agent_id (equal to the spawn agentId) and agent_type; its transcript_path is the main transcript. A workflow-agent payload has agent_type "workflow-subagent"; its journal is <main transcript minus .jsonl>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/journal.jsonl, in started and result lines; agent-<id>.meta.json holds agentType and model.
